output.reply: Thank you for contacting us. If your top-up was cancelled, any amount already debited from your account will be returned to you. Refunds for cancelled top-ups are typically processed back to the original payment method within a few business days. If the amount is not reflected in your account within that time, please reply with the top-up reference number so we can investigate further.

Thank you for letting us know about the reverted top-up. This can happen when a payment cannot be completed. If the funds were debited and the top-up was reversed, please allow a few business days for the money to return to your account. If it does not appear, contact our support team with the transaction details so we can investigate.

We're sorry about this. It looks like your top-up was reversed in the app. Could you provide the date, amount, and card used for the top-up so we can check the transaction? If the top-up was declined or reversed by your card issuer, the funds are usually returned automatically within a few business days. We'll investigate and update you as soon as we have more information.

Thank you for reaching out. Cash deposits can take up to one business day to appear in your account. Could you please provide the deposit date, amount, and branch or ATM location so we can look into it for you?

We're sorry your cash deposit hasn't appeared. Deposits can take a few business days to post, but since it's been a week, we'd like to investigate. Please reply with the deposit date, amount, and branch or ATM location (or the receipt number if you have it), and our team will trace the deposit and update you as soon as possible.

We're sorry to hear about this unauthorized charge. Please contact our fraud team immediately at 1-800-XXX-XXXX or through secure message in online banking. We can freeze your card, investigate the charge, and guide you through the dispute process. Do not share your account details with anyone.

Thank you for reaching out. A post office change of address does not update your details with the bank, so we recommend contacting us directly to confirm the address on your account before any card is sent. Once your address is verified as current, any card already ordered will be delivered to that address. Please let us know if you'd like us to review the status of your delivery.

Thank you for asking. We request identity details to protect your account and comply with legal regulations that require us to verify our customers' identities. This helps prevent fraud and keeps your funds and personal information secure. If you have concerns about any specific information requested, please let us know and we will explain why it is needed.

We ask for verification details to protect your account and comply with security regulations. This helps ensure only you can access your personal and financial information. Thank you for your patience and cooperation.

We're sorry you're having trouble logging in. Please make sure you're using the correct username and password, and try resetting your password via the 'Forgotten your login details?' link. If the issue continues, please contact our support team so we can check your account access.

Thank you for letting us know your new card has arrived. For security, we don't display your PIN, but you can view it in our mobile app under 'Card services > View PIN' after verifying your identity, or request a PIN reminder by calling the number on the back of your card. Please let us know if you need any further help.

For security reasons, we do not store or display your PIN anywhere in online or mobile banking. If you received your card by post, your PIN was sent separately. If you have forgotten your PIN, you can view or reset it in our mobile app under Card Settings, or contact our support team and we will arrange a replacement PIN.

Thank you for letting us know about the exchange rate applied to your card payment. Exchange rates are set by card networks at the time the transaction is processed and can include a foreign transaction fee. Please check your statement for the rate used, and if you still believe it is incorrect, contact our support team with the transaction details so we can review it for you.

Hello! You can top up your account by card in our mobile app or online banking: go to 'Top Up', select 'Debit/Credit Card', enter the amount and card details, and confirm. The funds are usually credited instantly. Please note a small fee may apply depending on your account type. Let us know if you need help with any step.

Thank you for asking! Yes, in most cases another person can send money to your account. They can transfer funds from their bank account or card to your account using your account details. Please note that transfers may be subject to our standard fees and processing times, and we may contact you if further verification is needed. If you'd like the exact details for receiving a transfer, our support team will be happy to help.

Yes, you can freeze your card immediately. Open our mobile app or online banking, go to 'Manage Cards', and select 'Freeze Card'. The freeze takes effect instantly and can be reversed anytime. If you suspect fraud, please contact our 24/7 support line as well.

Thank you for letting us know. We understand your concern about the exchange rate applied to your card payment. Foreign transaction rates can vary based on the payment network and the date the transaction was processed. Please review your statement and contact our support team with the transaction details so we can look into it for you.

Thank you for letting us know. We recommend first speaking with your child to confirm the transactions in question. If the charges were not authorised by you, please contact our card security team as soon as possible so we can review the transactions and, if needed, block and reissue your card. You will not be liable for unauthorised transactions reported promptly.

Thank you for reaching out. Your card can be used at any ATM displaying the Visa/Mastercard acceptance mark, as well as at all of our own branded ATMs free of charge. If a specific machine declines your card, please let us know the location so we can look into it.

I'm unable to see your exact location, but you can find the nearest ATM using the ATM locator in our mobile app or on our website. It will show distances and directions to the closest branches and ATMs.

We're sorry to see an unrecognized payment on your account. Please contact our fraud team immediately via the phone number on the back of your card or secure message in the app, so we can review the transaction, block it if still pending, and protect your account. Do not share your PIN or full card details with anyone.

We're sorry you were unable to withdraw cash. This can happen if your daily withdrawal limit was reached, the account balance was insufficient, the card was blocked, or the ATM was out of service. Please check your balance and limits in the app, and if the issue persists, contact our support line so we can review the declined transaction.

Hello, I'm sorry your ATM transaction was declined. Common reasons include exceeding your daily withdrawal limit, insufficient available funds, or a hold on your account. I'd be happy to look into this with you—if you can confirm the approximate time and location of the ATM, we can review the attempt and explain the specific cause.

Thank you for reaching out. Payments can take 1–3 business days to process depending on the payment method and the recipient's bank. If your payment is still showing as pending after this time, please provide the transaction date, amount, and recipient details, and we will review the status for you.

We're sorry to hear about your phone. To help protect your accounts, we recommend calling our 24/7 customer service line immediately so an agent can verify your identity and place a freeze on your accounts. Please note that freezes cannot be applied through this channel, as identity verification is required.

We're sorry to hear about your lost phone. You can still access your account by logging in through our website on a computer, or by calling customer support for identity verification. We also recommend calling us right away so we can deactivate mobile banking on the lost device and monitor your account for unusual activity.

Thank you for reaching out. We're sorry a payment may have been declined. Please check your available balance in the app or online banking to confirm sufficient funds, and make sure the card is active and not blocked. If funds are available and the issue continues, contact our support team so we can review the transaction. We cannot guarantee any transaction will be approved in advance.

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry for the concern this has caused. Refunds can take 3-5 business days to appear on your account, depending on the merchant and payment method. Could you confirm the date and amount of the refund so we can review the transaction on your account?

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Refunds can take 5–10 business days to appear on your statement depending on the merchant. If the refund still doesn't appear after that period, please contact us with the transaction details and we'll be happy to investigate.

Thank you for reaching out. Refunds can take 3–5 business days to appear on your statement, depending on the merchant. If it has been longer than that, please contact us with the transaction date, amount, and merchant name so we can review it for you.

We're sorry to see you want to close your account. For security reasons, account deletion must be requested through our secure channels — please visit your nearest branch with valid ID or call our support line. Note that any outstanding balance must be settled before closure.

I'm sorry to hear the ATM retained your card — I understand how stressful that can be. For your security, the card has likely been disabled and can no longer be used. Please contact our card services team or visit your nearest branch with valid ID to arrange a replacement card. If you notice any unfamiliar transactions, let us know right away so we can investigate.

We're sorry to hear your card was retained by the ATM. Please contact our 24/7 customer service line so we can verify the ATM location and arrange a card replacement. In the meantime, monitor your account and let us know immediately if you notice any unfamiliar transactions.

We're sorry to hear the ATM kept your card. For your security, the card has likely been retained and cannot be retrieved from the machine. Please call our card services team or visit a branch with ID so we can block the card and issue a replacement. Your account remains secure, and we're happy to help you access your funds in the meantime.

Hello! You can review all incoming transactions in your statement via our mobile app or online banking, where each deposit shows its origin (e.g., salary transfer, card refund, or incoming transfer). If a specific deposit is unclear, our support team can help identify the sender. Is there a particular transaction you'd like us to look into?

You can change your card PIN at any of our ATMs by selecting the 'PIN services' option after inserting your card, or by visiting a branch with valid photo ID. If you'd like further assistance, please contact our support team.

Thank you for reaching out! Yes, you can transfer money to a beneficiary. You can do this through online banking, our mobile app, or by visiting a branch. Please make sure you have the beneficiary's correct account details and the beneficiary's name. If you haven't added the beneficiary yet, you may need to add them first and wait for any required verification. Let us know if you need step-by-step help.

Thank you for reaching out. We're sorry you're having trouble exchanging crypto. Please try refreshing the app and confirming your account is fully verified, as verification and sufficient balance are required for crypto exchanges. If the issue persists, contact our support team with the error message and time of the attempt so we can investigate further.

Hello! There are several ways others can send you money: they can transfer funds to your account using your account number and our bank's routing number, send money via wire transfer, or use a mobile payment service linked to your account. For incoming international transfers, they may also need our SWIFT code. If you'd like the specific details for your account, please let us know and we'll be happy to assist.

We're sorry your transfer did not go through. Please check that your account has sufficient funds and that the recipient details are correct. Could you share the approximate time of the attempt and any error message you saw? This will help our team investigate and advise you on the next steps.

Thank you for reaching out. When a card payment appears to fail but later shows as 'in progress', it usually means the transaction is pending while the merchant's authorisation is being processed. In many cases, failed authorisations are released automatically within a few business days and no money is actually taken. We recommend monitoring the transaction in your app or online banking. If it remains pending beyond that period or the amount is debited incorrectly, please contact us again and we will investigate it for you.

Thank you for reaching out. You can make a transfer by logging into online banking or the mobile app, selecting 'Transfers,' choosing the recipient, entering the amount, and confirming the details. If you need help with a specific transfer, our support team is happy to assist.

A pending transaction is a charge that has been authorised but not yet fully posted to your account, so the funds are temporarily held. Pending transactions generally cannot be cancelled, and a declined ATM withdrawal may still show as pending briefly before it drops off, usually within a few business days. If it remains pending beyond that, please contact our support team so we can review the transaction for you.

Thank you for reaching out. You can pay by check by writing the amount payable to the biller or recipient, signing the check, and mailing or delivering it to the address provided by them. Please make sure you have sufficient funds in your account and keep the check number for your records. If you have any other questions, we're happy to help.

Hello! Thank you for reaching out. You can withdraw cash in your home currency from any of our ATMs that support this service, subject to your account's daily withdrawal limit and any applicable foreign transaction or out-of-network fees. Please note that machines abroad may also apply local charges. For the exact fees on your account, you can check your account terms in the mobile app or contact our support team. Have a wonderful holiday!

Thank you for reaching out. Depending on your account type and the ATM operator, additional fees may apply when withdrawing British pounds from a local ATM. These can include our foreign cash withdrawal fee and any fee charged by the ATM provider, which the machine typically displays before you confirm. If you share your account type, I can point you to the exact fee details on our current schedule of charges so you know what to expect before withdrawing your travel cash.

Hi! If disposable virtual cards are available on your account, you can create one by logging into online banking or the mobile app, going to the 'Cards' section, and selecting 'Create virtual card.' Each disposable card is single-use and details are deleted after the transaction. If you don't see this option, your account type may not include virtual cards—please contact our support team for help.

Thank you for reaching out. Transfer arrival times depend on the transfer type and destination: internal transfers are usually credited the same business day, while domestic transfers typically take 1–2 business days and international transfers 3–5 business days. Once the funds are credited, they will appear in your account balance immediately. If your transfer takes longer than expected, please contact us with the transfer reference and we will look into it.

Thank you for letting us know about the unexpected balance showing in your app. Balances can sometimes reflect pending items that have not yet fully cleared. Please do not spend these funds, as the amount may be adjusted. If the amount is still showing incorrectly, contact our support team with your account details so we can review the transaction for you.

Thank you for your question! In addition to USD, our accounts support several other currencies, including EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, and AUD. Availability may vary by account type. Please let us know if you'd like more details about a specific currency or how to open a multi-currency account.

Hello! You can find our current exchange rates on our website under the 'Foreign Exchange' section, or in the mobile app by selecting an account and tapping 'Exchange Rates'. Rates are updated regularly, so please check at the time of your transaction, as the final rate may vary. Let us know if you need anything else!

Thank you for reaching out. Our standard currency exchange rates and any applicable fees are the same regardless of transaction volume, so we do not currently offer discounts on multiple exchanges. Please visit your local branch or our website for the current rates. We're happy to help with any other questions.

Thank you for your question. We do not charge a fee for topping up your account by standard methods such as bank transfer or debit card; however, some third-party providers may apply their own charges. For the full list of applicable fees, please visit our fees page or contact our support team.

Thank you for your question. Adding money with an international card may involve a processing fee, which can vary depending on the card's issuing country and currency. Please check our fee schedule in the app or contact support with your card details so we can give you the exact amount before you make the transfer.

Thank you for reaching out. To activate your new card, you can use our mobile app under 'Card Services,' log in to online banking, or call the activation number printed on the sticker on your card. If you run into any issues, we're happy to assist further.

Thank you for reaching out! You can activate your new card by logging into online or mobile banking and selecting 'Activate Card,' or by calling the number on the back of your card. If you need any help during the process, we're happy to assist.

Thank you for reaching out. To activate your new card, log in to online or mobile banking and select 'Activate Card', or call the number on the sticker attached to the card and follow the prompts. You may need to verify your identity and provide the card's expiration date. Please don't share your PIN with anyone.

Thank you for reaching out. To activate your card, you can do so via our mobile banking app, online banking, or by calling the activation number on the sticker attached to your card. If you need any assistance during the process, our support team is happy to help.

We understand you need your card as soon as possible. Cards are typically dispatched within 3-5 business days of approval. If your card hasn't arrived within the expected timeframe, please contact us and we can check its delivery status and discuss a replacement or expedited options where available.

Thank you for reaching out. Withdrawal fees can apply when using out-of-network ATMs or making withdrawals in a foreign currency, as outlined in our fee schedule. Your specific account type may also affect applicable fees. If you believe a fee was charged in error or would like details about a specific transaction, please contact our support team with the transaction details so we can review it for you.

You can order a replacement card in advance of its expiry: log in to online or mobile banking, go to the Cards section, and select 'Order replacement card'. Your new card will typically arrive 7–10 business days before the current one expires. Please let us know if you need any help with the steps.

No need to order a new card — a replacement card will be sent automatically to your registered address before your current card expires. If it hasn't arrived about two weeks before the expiry date, please contact us and we'll look into it.

Thank you for reaching out. At this time, Apple Pay top-ups are only supported with Visa and Mastercard debit and credit cards, which is why your American Express card is not accepted. You can top up your account using a supported card, a bank transfer, or one of our alternative payment methods. If you have any other questions, we're happy to help.

Thank you for reaching out. Yes, you can top up your account using Apple Pay if your Apple Pay is linked to an eligible debit or credit card. Simply select the top-up option in your app or online banking and choose Apple Pay as the payment method. Please note that standard card top-up limits and any applicable fees may apply.

Thank you for reaching out. We'd be happy to help you complete identity verification. To get started, please log in to your online banking profile or visit your nearest branch with a valid government-issued ID. If you're having trouble with a specific step, let us know and we'll guide you through it.

Thank you for reaching out. To check whether we support your country, could you please tell us which country you are located in? You can also visit our website's Help section for the full list of supported countries. We'll be happy to assist once we have more details.

Hello! Thank you for your question. Yes, auto top-up is subject to daily and per-transaction limits, which can vary depending on your account type and the funding card. You can view your current limits in the mobile app under 'Card Settings' or by contacting our support team, who can confirm the specific limits applicable to your account.

Thank you for reaching out. Yes, in most cases you can set up an automatic top-up for your travel money card. You can do this through online banking or the mobile app by selecting your card, choosing 'Top-up settings', and setting a threshold and amount. If you'd like, we can walk you through the steps or review your account to confirm eligibility—just let us know.

We're sorry you're having trouble with your card. Please make sure it hasn't expired or been blocked, and that you're within your daily limits. If the issue persists, call the number on the back of your card or visit a branch so we can check the card's status and assist you further.

Thank you for reaching out. Cards can take a short time to appear in the app after activation, and logging out and back in or updating the app may help. If your card still doesn't show up, please contact our support team so we can check the status of your card on your account.

Thank you for reaching out! Our app displays current exchange rates, but currency exchange between accounts is not available directly in the app at this time. If you'd like to exchange currency, please visit a branch or contact our support team, who will be happy to assist you.

Thank you for your question. Our app supports exchange between a range of major currencies; the full, up-to-date list is available in the app under the exchange section, where applicable rates are also shown before you confirm any transaction. Please let us know if you need help finding it.

We're sorry to hear about your lost wallet. Please call our 24/7 card hotline immediately so we can block your cards right away. Once blocked, we can order replacement cards to be sent to your address on file. Please note that for security reasons, we cannot block cards via this channel alone.

Thank you for reaching out. Accounts for minors can typically be opened by a parent or legal guardian, who must complete identity verification and provide the child's documentation, such as a birth certificate. Please visit a branch or contact our support team so we can confirm the specific requirements and eligible account types for your situation.

Thank you for your interest in opening an account. Generally, customers aged 18 or older can open an account independently, while minors may open certain accounts with a parent or legal guardian as a joint holder. Requirements can vary by account type, so please check the specific product details on our website or contact a branch for exact eligibility criteria.

For security reasons, your PIN cannot be viewed online or in the app. If you've forgotten it, you can request a PIN reminder in the app or by contacting our support team, and we'll send a new PIN to your registered address.

Thank you for reaching out. To review your contactless payment settings, open our mobile app and go to Cards > Manage Card > Security Settings, where you can confirm that contactless payments are enabled. You can also call the number on the back of your card if you'd like assistance from a representative.

Thank you for letting us know about the contactless issue. This can happen if your card is new and contactless hasn't been activated yet (make a chip-and-PIN payment first), if the card is damaged, or if the terminal is faulty. Please also check that contactless payments are enabled for your card in our mobile app. If the problem persists, we recommend contacting our card services team or visiting a branch so we can check your card status and, if needed, issue a replacement.

Thank you for letting us know you found your card! You can add it to the app by going to the 'Cards' section and selecting 'Add a card', then following the prompts to verify your details. If the card was previously reported lost or blocked, you may need to contact our support team to reactivate it before adding it.

Thank you for letting us know you're having trouble with contactless payments. Please first confirm that contactless is enabled on your card and that your card hasn't been locked in the mobile app. If the issue persists after trying a payment terminal you've used before, contact our support team at the number on the back of your card so we can check your card's status and, if needed, arrange a replacement.

Thank you for reaching out! To use contactless payments, look for the contactless symbol (wave icon) on your card or in your mobile wallet, then simply hold your card or phone near the terminal at checkout until you see confirmation. If your card doesn't have contactless capability, you can visit a branch to request one. Is there anything else we can help you with?

Thank you for reaching out. Whether you are charged when receiving money depends on the type of transfer — for example, incoming domestic transfers are typically free, while some international incoming transfers may carry a fee. Please check our fee schedule or contact your local branch for details specific to your account.

Thank you for reaching out. Card top-ups can sometimes take longer to process due to verification checks by your card issuer. If your top-up remains pending for more than 24 hours, please contact our support team with the transaction details so we can look into it for you.

A 'pending' status means your top-up has been received but hasn't fully processed yet. This usually resolves within a few hours, though card transfers can take up to 3 business days. If it remains pending longer than that, please contact us with the transaction reference so we can look into it.

Thank you for reaching out. Top-up limits are set based on your account type and verification status, and they cannot be changed instantly on request. To check your current limit and the options available to you, please contact our support team via the app or visit your local branch with valid identification, and we'll be happy to review your account.

Thank you for your enquiry. Our current exchange rates vary by currency and are updated regularly. You can view today's rates on our website under 'Foreign Exchange' or in the mobile app. Rates applied to a transaction are confirmed at the time of the exchange. Please let us know if you'd like help with a specific currency.

We're sorry to hear your transaction failed. This can happen due to insufficient funds, daily limits, or a temporary issue with the merchant or card. Please check your account balance and limits, then try again. If it continues, contact our support team with the transaction details so we can investigate.

Hello! We accept deposits in USD, EUR, and GBP. Foreign currency deposits may be subject to conversion fees at our prevailing exchange rate. Please let us know if you'd like more details on a specific currency.

A virtual card is a digital version of your debit or credit card, stored in your mobile banking app. It has its own card number, expiry date, and security code, so you can make secure online purchases or add it to a digital wallet without waiting for a physical card. If you'd like, you can find or activate yours under the 'Cards' section of the app, and our support team is happy to help if you run into any issues.

Hello! You can find your virtual cards by logging into online banking or the mobile app and going to the 'Cards' section, then selecting 'Virtual cards'. If you don't see any virtual cards there, you may need to request one first — let us know if you'd like help with that.

Thank you for your enquiry. Our cards are accepted at all merchants displaying the card network logo (e.g. Visa/Mastercard), both in-store and online, as well as at ATMs within our partner networks. If you let us know your specific card type, we can confirm the exact networks that apply.

Thank you for your question. Your card can generally be used at any merchant or ATM that displays the card network logo shown on your card (e.g., Visa or Mastercard). Acceptance may vary by country and merchant, and some locations may require a PIN or contactless-enabled terminal. If you plan to travel, we recommend letting us know in advance so your card usage abroad goes smoothly. Please contact us if you'd like more details.
